rules.memoryDeletionGate: Deleting Sibyl Memory must cause the claimed core function to fail or materially degrade. The video must show fresh-session recall, the README must point to critical reads and writes, and a deletion test must demonstrate the break.
rules.pmfBonus: Up to 10 points; nonzero requires a publicly verifiable artifact showing a named audience and validated pain point, usage, pilot, waitlist, or design partner.
rules.partnerMultiplier: Base or Virtuals count only when doing real product work in the demo. Base deployment is the eligibility floor; an executed on-chain action earns its bonus. First partner +15%, second +10%, capped at 1.25x.
rules.mainnetRequirement: The rules require an executed on-chain action for the Base bonus; they do not expressly say that it must be on mainnet. This project specification independently requires Base mainnet attestations.
rules.submissionRequirements: Public OSI-licensed GitHub repository with real commit history; 2–5 minute demo including fresh-session recall; README; two public posts.

sibylMemory.languageDecision: Python 3.12 with mypy --strict. The official direct SDK is Python-first; installed package sibyl-memory-client 0.8.0 in a Python 3.12.13 preflight virtual environment.
sibylMemory.auth: MemoryClient.local() works locally without credentials. CLI activation is sibyl init and writes credentials to ~/.sibyl-memory/credentials.json; it is not required for the local SDK test.
sibylMemory.client: from sibyl_memory_client import MemoryClient; MemoryClient.local(path, tenant_id=...)

sibylMemory.tierAndSizeLimits: Free plan documentation reports a 5,242,880-byte cap. Actual project cap remains to be checked after activation if it will exceed this.

helloWorld.archiveResult: archive_entity returned archived_id and original_id. get_entity then correctly reported not found. list_entities(status='archived') returned an empty list, and no restore method appears on MemoryClient 0.8.0.

sibylMemory.blocker: The published API does not expose a documented archive read or restore operation, despite the docs describing archive as recoverable. Phase 1 cannot claim archive-and-resurrect until Sibyl documents a supported retrieval/restore path or the team confirms an acceptable implementation using the real local store.
